mentions.name: Ziva
mentions.description: An AI game development agent for Godot that lets users chat about and modify things in their game. It automatically adds open scripts, scenes, and assets to context and uses around 50 MCP tools for editing. Work is underway to refactor the agent loop onto the Claude Agent SDK to piggyback on the Claude Code developer experience and focus on the tool and integration side.
mentions.problem: Big games are made in game engines, and game engines are hard.
